subject: Signatory authority gap analysis & envelope schedule for MSA + Order Form
body:
From: Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acme-corp.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, legal@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Signatory list and DocuSign routing for Redwood MSA + Order Form

Hi Kimberly,

We're finalizing our internal sign-off for the MSA + Order Form and need to confirm a few items before we proceed with DocuSign:

- Who will be signing on Redwood's side (name, title) and do you have a corporate authorization (POA or board resolution) for that signer?
- Preferred routing order (ACME to sign first, or Redwood prepares and sends for signature?) and whether you need us to provide any witness or notarization.
- Can you provide a draft of the final clean copy (MSA + completed OF) for our legal review so we can confirm there are no redline carry-overs?

We need the above by EOD Thursday to meet our legal team's window. Attaching our signer requirements doc for reference.

Thanks,
Elena Sanchez
Contracts Manager
Acme Corp

Attachment: ACME_signer_requirements.pdf

-----
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Signatory list and DocuSign routing for Redwood MSA + Order Form

Hi Elena — thanks for the checklist. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Redwood signers
   - Primary signer: Marcus Lin, VP Legal (marcus_lin@redwood.com)
   - Alternate (if Marcus unavailable): Alex Martinez, Head of Partnerships (alex_martinez@redwood.com)
   - Attached: redwood-signatory-delegation.pdf (delegation summary + threshold limits)

2) Routing and timing
   - We typically prepare the envelope, upload the final clean copies, and send to ACME for signature first (ACME signs), then Redwood countersigns. This lets ACME confirm order-form fields before our final countersignature.
   - Proposed routing order: Elena (Primary ACME signer) -> procurement@acme-corp.com (PO approver) -> Marcus (countersign).
   - Estimated send date: Wednesday 12/3 if we confirm the clean copy today.

3) Clean copies
   - Attached is a near-final clean PDF (draft_clean_copy_MSA+OF_20261203.pdf). Marcus will confirm legal redlines; please flag any remaining items.

I'll loop Marcus and Alex for authority proof and envelope setup.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: alex_martinez@redwood.com, legal@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Signatory list and DocuSign routing for Redwood MSA + Order Form

Elena / Kimberly — confirming authority and constraints.

- I have delegated signing authority for MSAs and Order Forms up to $2.5M per company; scope covers the documents shared. I am available to countersign electronically via DocuSign.
- Attaching formal resolution: resolution_2026-11-15.pdf (signed by Board Secretary).
- No notarization required for Redwood's countersignature; we will countersign after ACME completes signatures.
- For audit, please include a visible signatory block for Redwood (Name/Title/Email) and a signature/date field.

Routing note: If ACME requires Redwood to sign first for any reason, please flag immediately; otherwise we'll proceed with ACME-first flow.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
VP, Legal — Redwood Inference

Attachment: resolution_2026-11-15.pdf

-----
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -08:00
Subject: DocuSign envelope plan + handover checklist for revenue ops

Team / Elena — prepping the envelope. Proposed details below: 

- Envelope name: Redwood-ACME-MSA-OF-2026-12
- Documents: MSA_clean_20261203.pdf, OrderForm_ACME_20261203.pdf (combined into one envelope); I'll attach the final PDF when confirmed.
- Routing order: 1) Elena Sanchez (ACME legal) -> 2) procurement@acme-corp.com -> 3) Marcus Lin (Redwood countersign).
- Signer authentication: email + access code (ACME prefers access code for procurement). Please confirm the access code to use or if ACME wants SMS verification.
- Envelope visibility: Once fully executed, set to auto-email final PDF to accounts@acme-corp.com and to revenue-ops@redwood.com.

Actions for Kimberly / Laura:
- Kimberly: confirm PO/Order Form numbers match ACME internal PO so procurement can validate.
- Laura: after envelope completes, please pull final PDF, upload to the Acme folder in Drive, and attach to HubSpot deal ACME-2026-014.

Attachment: draft_clean_copy_MSA+OF_20261203.pdf

-----
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: DocuSign envelope sent — Redwood/ACME MSA + Order Form (Envelope ID & next steps)

Elena / team — sending final confirmation that the DocuSign envelope has been created and sent to ACME signers. Summary below:

- Envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h
- Sent: 2026-12-07 16:40 PST
- Routing order active: Elena Sanchez -> procurement@acme-corp.com -> Marcus Lin (countersign)
- Signer authentication: Elena via email link; procurement via access code (we set code = ACME-PO-2026). Please confirm if you want a different code.
- Attachments included in envelope: MSA_clean_20261203.pdf, OrderForm_ACME_20261203.pdf

Post-sign handover plan:
- Laura (revenue ops) to download final executed PDF from DocuSign and upload to Drive (link below) within 24 hours of final signature.
- Kimberly to update HubSpot deal ACME-2026-014 with executed docs and change deal stage to Closed-Won after countersignature.
- I'll also send the final clean copy to accounts@acme-corp.com for invoicing.

DocuSign link (for ACME signers): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h
Drive folder (post-sign): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHijKlMnOp

Let me know if ACME needs witness language included or any last-minute edits — otherwise we'll proceed.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: DocuSign-envelope-ACME-2026-12-07.pdf

-----
On Tue, Dec 7, 2026 at 17:05 Elena Sanchez <elena.sanchez@acme-corp.com> wrote:

Thanks — confirmed receipt and routing. Procurement will respond with access code confirmation by EOD tomorrow.

Elena
Contracts Manager, Acme Corp
